en: theoretically / from a theoretical perspective
fr: théoriquement / d'un point de vue théorique
ur: نظریاتی لحاظ سے
definition_en: Phrase narrowing the discussion to the concepts and rules of a matter, rather than its practical application.
example_ar: هَذَا صَحِيحٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ تَنْظِيرِيَّةٍ.
example_en: This is correct from a theoretical perspective.
related: نَظَرِيًّا, اِفْتِرَاضِيًّا

en: by pure coincidence / purely accidental
fr: par pure coïncidence / par pur hasard
ur: محض اتفاقاً / بالکل اتفاقیہ
definition_en: Emphatic version of 'min qubayl al-misadafa'. Asserts that an event had absolutely no prior planning or connection.
example_ar: اِلْتَقَيْنَا مِنْ قُبَيْلِ الصُّدْفَةِ المَحْضَةِ.
example_en: We met by pure coincidence.
related: صُدْفَةً تَمَامًا, بِلَا تَرْتِيبٍ

en: on a purely theoretical scale
fr: sur un plan purement théorique
ur: خالص نظریاتی سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase emphasizing that the discussion is entirely academic and has no immediate practical application or testing.
example_ar: نَدْرُسُ القَاعِدَةَ عَلَى نِطَاقٍ تَنْظِيرِيٍّ مَحْضٍ.
example_en: We study the rule on a purely theoretical scale.
related: فَلْسَفِيًّا, اِفْتِرَاضِيًّا

en: on an awareness-raising scale / for public awareness
fr: à l'échelle de la sensibilisation
ur: آگاہی کی سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase describing actions or campaigns designed to inform the public about a specific issue (e.g., health, environment).
example_ar: الحَمْلَةُ تَعْمَلُ عَلَى نِطَاقٍ تَوْعَوِيٍّ.
example_en: The campaign works on an awareness-raising scale.
related: لِلإِعْلامِ, لِلتَّثْقِيفِ

en: by purely random coincidence / purely by chance
fr: par pur hasard / par coïncidence pure et simple
ur: محض اتفاقاً / بالکل اتفاقیہ
definition_en: Emphatic version of 'min qubayl al-misadafa'. Asserts that there was absolutely no prior plan, intent, or hidden connection.
example_ar: رَأَيْتُهُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المُصَادَفَةِ البَحْتَةِ.
example_en: I saw him purely by chance.
related: صُدْفَةً تَمَامًا, بِلَا قَصْدٍ أَبَدًا

en: from a socio-anthropological perspective
fr: d'un point de vue socio-anthropologique
ur: سماجی اور بشریاتی (انسانی ارتقاء کے) لحاظ سے
definition_en: Academic phrase narrowing the discussion to the study of human societies, cultures, and their development.
example_ar: هَذِهِ العَادَةُ هَامَّةٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ اِجْتِمَاعِيَّةٍ أَنْتْرُوبُولُوجِيَّةٍ.
example_en: This custom is important from a socio-anthropological perspective.
related: عِلْمِيًّا, لِدِرَاسَةِ الشُّعُوبِ

en: from a macroeconomic perspective
fr: d'un point de vue macroéconomique
ur: میکرو اکنامک (بڑے پیمانے کے معاشی) لحاظ سے
definition_en: Phrase narrowing the discussion to large-scale economic factors like national income, inflation, and growth.
example_ar: البَلَدُ بِخَيْرٍ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ اِفْتِصَادِيَّةٍ كُلِّيَّةٍ.
example_en: The country is fine from a macroeconomic perspective.
related: لِلاِقْتِصَادِ الكَبِيرِ, نَظْرَةٌ شَامِلَةٌ

en: on a social awareness scale
fr: à une échelle de sensibilisation sociale
ur: سماجی آگاہی (بیداری) کی سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase describing efforts to educate a whole society about a specific problem like health, drugs, or rights.
example_ar: الحَمْلَةُ تَعْمَلُ عَلَى نِطَاقٍ تَوْعَوِيٍّ اِجْتِمَاعِيٍّ.
example_en: The campaign works on a social awareness scale.
related: لِتَنْبِيهِ النَّاسِ, تَعْلِيمٌ جَمَاعِيٌّ

en: for the purpose of winning over / for attraction
fr: à des fins de séduction / pour attirer
ur: مائل کرنے (جیتنے) کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone to join a side, to like a product, or to gain their favor through kindness or persuasion.
example_ar: تَكَلَّمَ بِلُطْفٍ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ.
example_en: He spoke kindly for the purpose of winning over.
related: لِلاِقْنِاعِ, لِجَذْبِ النَّاسِ

en: for the purpose of intellectual winning over / conversion
fr: à des fins de séduction intellectuelle / de conversion
ur: فکری طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone to accept a new philosophy, religion, or political theory through reason.
example_ar: كَتَبَ الكِتَابَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الفِكْرِيَّةِ.
example_en: He wrote the book for the purpose of intellectual winning over.
related: لِلاِقْنِاعِ الثَّقَافِيِّ, لِتَغْيِيرِ الرَّأْيِ

en: for the purpose of emotional winning over / manipulation
fr: à des fins de séduction émotionnelle / de manipulation
ur: جذباتی طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to play on someone's feelings (pity, love, or anger) to get them to agree with a point or side.
example_ar: بَكَى بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ العَاطِفِيَّةِ.
example_en: He cried for the purpose of emotional winning over.
related: لِلتَّأْثِيرِ النَّفْسِيِّ, لِجَذْبِ القَلْبِ

en: for the purpose of professional winning over / networking
fr: à des fins de séduction professionnelle / de réseautage
ur: پیشہ ورانہ طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince a colleague, a boss, or a client to support your work or join your business project.
example_ar: أَرْسَلَ السِّيرَةَ الذَّاتِيَّةَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ المِهَنِيَّةِ.
example_en: He sent the CV for the purpose of professional winning over.
related: لِكَسْبِ ثِقَةِ الزُّمَلَاءِ, لِلْعَمَلِ

en: for the purpose of artistic winning over / aesthetic appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction artistique / d'attrait esthétique
ur: فنی (آرٹسٹک) طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince an audience through beauty, style, or creative skill rather than logic.
example_ar: زَيَّنَ الكِتَابَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الفَنِّيَّةِ.
example_en: He decorated the book for the purpose of artistic winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ الذَّوْقِ, لِلْجَمَالِ

en: for the purpose of diplomatic winning over / lobbying
fr: à des fins de séduction diplomatique / de lobbying
ur: سفارتی طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince foreign governments or international organizations to support a specific policy or peace plan.
example_ar: زَارَ الوَزِيرُ العَاصِمَةَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الدِّبْلُومَاسِيَّةِ.
example_en: The minister visited the capital for the purpose of diplomatic winning over.
related: لِكَسْبِ الحُلَفَاءِ, لِلسِّيَاسَةِ الدَّوْلِيَّةِ

en: for the purpose of logical winning over / persuasion
fr: à des fins de séduction logique / de persuasion
ur: منطقی طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone using cold facts, numbers, and clear reasoning rather than emotion or style.
example_ar: قَدَّمَ الأَدِلَّةَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ المَنْطِقِيَّةِ.
example_en: He presented evidence for the purpose of logical winning over.
related: لِلاِقْنِاعِ بِالعَقْلِ, لِلْبُرْهَانِ

en: for the purpose of classical winning over / traditional appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction classique / d'attrait traditionnel
ur: کلاسیکی طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone using old-fashioned, high-culture, or traditionally elegant methods (like a formal poem or a handwritten letter).
example_ar: كَتَبَ الرِّسَالَةَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الكِلاسِيكِيَّةِ.
example_en: He wrote the letter for the purpose of classical winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ القُلُوبِ بِالأَدَبِ, لِلْجَمَالِ القَدِيمِ

en: for the purpose of genius winning over / brilliant appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction géniale / d'attrait brillant
ur: عبقری (جینیئس) طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone using a plan so brilliant and complex that it looks like it was created by a genius.
example_ar: صَمَّمَ المَشْرُوعَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ العَبْقَرِيَّةِ.
example_en: He designed the project for the purpose of genius winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ العُقُولِ الذَّكِيَّةِ, لِلإِبْدَاعِ الفَرِيدِ

en: for the purpose of epic winning over / heroic appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction épique / d'attrait héroïque
ur: رزمیہ (ایپک) طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince a nation or a group by invoking great stories of heroes, battles, and legendary glory.
example_ar: خَطَبَ المَلِكُ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ المَلَحِمِيَّةِ.
example_en: The king spoke for the purpose of epic winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ قُلُوبِ الفُرْسَانِ, لِلْمَجْدِ العَظِيمِ

en: for the purpose of cinematic winning over / visual storytelling
fr: à des fins de séduction cinématographique / de narration visuelle
ur: سینمائی (مووی) طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince an audience by using powerful images, lighting, and dramatic music, like in a movie.
example_ar: صَوَّرَ الإِعْلَانَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ السِّينِمَائِيَّةِ.
example_en: He filmed the advertisement for the purpose of cinematic winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ الأَنْظَارِ بِالفَنِّ, لِلصُّورَةِ المُؤَثِّرَةِ

en: for the purpose of architectural winning over / structural appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction architecturale / d'attrait structurel
ur: معمارانہ (آرکیٹیکچرل) طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone by showing them beautiful buildings, grand designs, and perfect urban planning.
example_ar: بَنَى القَصْرَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ المِعْمَارِيَّةِ.
example_en: He built the palace for the purpose of architectural winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ القُلُوبِ بِالبُنْيَانِ, لِلْجَمَالِ المَبْنِيِّ

en: at your own scientific and genetic discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion scientifique et génétique
ur: آپ کی اپنی سائنسی اور جینیاتی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Focuses entirely on the listener's understanding of DNA, heredity, and the biological code of life.
example_ar: عَدِّلِ الخَلِيَّةَ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العِلْمِيِّ الجِينِيِّ.
example_en: Edit the cell at your own scientific and genetic discretion.
related: حَسْبَ الشَّفْرَةِ الوِرَاثِيَّةِ, لِلْعَالِمِ الجِينِيِّ

en: for the purpose of philosophical winning over / intellectual appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction philosophique / d'attrait intellectuel
ur: فلسفیانہ طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone by using deep questions about life, existence, and the meaning of the soul.
example_ar: نَاقَشَ الوُجُودَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الفَلْسَفِيَّةِ.
example_en: He discussed existence for the purpose of philosophical winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ العُقُولِ بِالحِكْمَةِ, لِلْبَحْثِ عَنِ الحَقِيقَةِ

en: for the purpose of physical winning over / material appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction physique / d'attrait matériel
ur: مادی (فزیکل) طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone by showing them physical objects, material wealth, or the strength of one's body.
example_ar: قَدَّمَ المَالَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الفِيزْيَائِيَّةِ.
example_en: He presented the money for the purpose of physical winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ الحَوَاسِّ, لِلمَادَّةِ المَلْمُوسَةِ

en: for the purpose of chemical winning over / hormonal appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction chimique / d'attrait hormonal
ur: کیمیائی طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone by using perfumes, medicines, or things that affect the body's internal chemistry and feelings.
example_ar: اِسْتَعْمَلَ العِطْرَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الكِيمْيَائِيَّةِ.
example_en: He used perfume for the purpose of chemical winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ الجَسَدِ, لِلتَّأْثِيرِ الحَيَوِيِّ

en: for the purpose of geological winning over / territorial appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction géologique / d'attrait territorial
ur: جیو لوجیکل طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone by showing them the value of the rocks, minerals, and the deep earth secrets of a land.
example_ar: نَقَّبَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الجِيُولوجِيَّةِ.
example_en: He prospected for the purpose of geological winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ النَّاسِ بِالثَّرَوَاتِ, لِلأَرْضِ العَمِيقَةِ

en: for the purpose of astronomical winning over / cosmic appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction astronomique / d'attrait cosmique
ur: فلکیاتی (ایسٹرونومیکل) طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone by showing them the beauty of the stars, the planets, and the vastness of the universe.
example_ar: رَصَدَ النُّجُومَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الفَلَكِيَّةِ.
example_en: He observed the stars for the purpose of astronomical winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ النُّفُوسِ بِالفَضَاءِ, لِجَمَالِ السَّمَاءِ العَمِيقِ

en: for the purpose of genetic winning over / hereditary appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction génétique / d'attrait héréditaire
ur: جینیاتی طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone by showing them the value of their DNA, their ancestry, and the biological power of their family line.
example_ar: دَرَسَ السُّلالَةَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الجِينِيَّةِ.
example_en: He studied the lineage for the purpose of genetic winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ النَّاسِ بِأَصْلِهِمْ, لِلشَّفْرَةِ الوِرَاثِيَّةِ

en: for the purpose of sociological winning over / social appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction sociologique / d'attrait social
ur: عمرانیاتی (سوشل بیالوجیکل) طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince a group of people by understanding their social habits, their fears, and their group identity.
example_ar: خَاطَبَ الشَّعْبَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ السُّوسِيُولُوجِيَّةِ.
example_en: He addressed the people for the purpose of sociological winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ الجَمَاهِيرِ بِالفَهْمِ, لِلْوَاقِعِ الاِجْتِمَاعِيِّ

en: for the purpose of spiritual winning over / soulful appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction spirituelle / d'attrait de l'âme
ur: روحانی طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone by speaking to their soul, their conscience, and their deep internal connection to the Divine.
example_ar: خَاطَبَ القَلْبَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الرُّوحَانِيَّةِ.
example_en: He addressed the heart for the purpose of spiritual winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ النُّفُوسِ بِالإِيمَانِ, لِلصَّفَاءِ الدَّاخِلِيِّ

en: for the purpose of intellectual winning over / rational appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction intellectuelle / d'attrait rationnel
ur: عقلی طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone by using pure logic, facts, and the power of the human mind.
example_ar: نَاقَشَ الفَيْلسُوفُ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ العَقْلِيَّةِ.
example_en: The philosopher discussed for the purpose of intellectual winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ النُّفُوسِ بِالمَنْطِقِ, لِلفَهْمِ العَمِيقِ

en: for the purpose of cosmic winning over / universal appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction cosmique / d'attrait universel
ur: آفاقی طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone by using the power, mystery, and the absolute laws of the entire universe.
example_ar: نَظَرَ إِلَى النُّجُومِ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الكَوْنِيَّةِ.
example_en: He looked at the stars for the purpose of cosmic winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ النُّفُوسِ بِالحَقِيقَةِ الكُبْرَى, لِلفَضَاءِ العَمِيقِ

en: for the purpose of ecological winning over / nature appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction écologique / d'attrait de la nature
ur: ایکولوجیکل (ماحولیاتی) طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone by showing them the beauty, balance, and the absolute power of nature and the planet.
example_ar: صَوَّرَ الغَابَةَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الإِيكُولُوجِيَّةِ.
example_en: He photographed the forest for the purpose of ecological winning over.
related: لِجَذْبِ النُّفُوسِ بِالطَّبِيعَةِ, لِلْبِيئَةِ الخَضْرَاءِ

en: for the purpose of geo-political winning over / border-based appeal
fr: à des fins de séduction géopolitique / d'attrait des frontières
ur: جیو پولیٹیکل طور پر مائل کرنے کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to convince someone by using the power of maps, the location of land, and the absolute rules of international power.
example_ar: رَسَمَ الخَرِيْطَةَ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِمَالَةِ الجِيُوبُولِيتِيكِيَّةِ.
